instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova Industries is a micro-firm providing essential municipal services including urban planning, waste management logistics, and social support. Operating within a low regulatory environment allows for agile service delivery, though it exposes the company to risk from rapid shifts in public policy.
answers.pastInitiatives: The firm attempted to implement a customer self-service portal two years ago using an external agency, which resulted in very low adoption rates. This failure highlighted a lack of upfront market validation regarding user needs and led the company to prioritize internal process optimization over large-scale digital initiatives.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next two years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows.
answers.additionalContext: The firm operates primarily on a lean budget with limited technical expertise, meaning innovation efforts must be heavily focused on maximizing existing operational workflows before considering new technology investments.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Workflow Automation via RPA
opportunities.rationale: Automating repetitive tasks in order processing and invoicing directly addresses the goal of reducing manual labor costs and improving operational efficiency immediately. This is a low-risk, high-ROI initiative that aligns perfectly with the conservative risk appetite.

first_actions: Conduct an internal audit mapping all top 5 most time-consuming administrative tasks.
Identify one high-volume administrative task suitable for Robotic Process Automation (RPA) pilot testing.
resources_needed: One external RPA consultant retainer (budget allocation: 3%)
Internal time allocated by the founder (5 hours/week).
execution_plan.success_metric: 10% reduction in administrative processing time within Q2.
milestones: Pilot project scope defined and approved (Month 1)

opportunities.title: Data Consolidation for Predictive Maintenance Alerts
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing sensor data (waste bins/traffic) to create simple, automated alerts can move the company from reactive maintenance to predictive efficiency. This requires minimal new tech investment and leverages current digital maturity.

first_actions: Integrate all existing sensor feeds into a centralized database.
Develop a dashboard showing threshold breaches for proactive scheduling.
resources_needed: Subscription cost for basic cloud data warehousing service (budget allocation: 2%)
execution_plan.success_metric: 90% accuracy in predicting bin overflow events before they occur.

opportunities.title: Low-Code Citizen Service Agent Interface
opportunities.rationale: Developing a highly streamlined, low-code interface for citizens to request specific services (e.g., permit applications) could boldize the service delivery experience, moving beyond simple self-service into guided digital interaction.

first_actions: Identify one core high-friction administrative process (e.g., small business permitting).
Explore using a no-code platform (e.g., Bubble) to prototype the interface.
resources_needed: Dedicated external UI/UX designer consultation (budget allocation: 5%)
Founder time dedicated solely to UX flow definition.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 40% digital intake of core service requests within the year.
milestones: Beta testing with a small municipal department (Month 8)

next_steps.action: Hold a cross-departmental workshop focused on identifying the top three manual bottlenecks and prioritizing them for RPA.
Allocate 3% of operating budget immediately to secure initial consulting hours for the RPA pilot project scope definition.

key_weaknesses: Extreme reliance on a single founder leading all technical and strategic decisions, creating a bottleneck.
Minimal digital maturity (Level 1) resulting in high reliance on manual, error-prone processes.
Severe budget constraints limiting investment flexibility and making radical shifts unfeasible without external funding.
Lack of dedicated, formal engineering or process management staff to scale efficiency gains.
